result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. No other visually broken elements were detected, excluding expected horizontal scroll clipping and bottom viewport cutoff.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, with the same image, 15-25 min delivery time, and €0.90 delivery fee, suggesting duplicated data or a rendering loop.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list by unique restaurant/location ID before rendering, and investigate the carousel data source. If these are distinct locations, differentiate them with location-specific labels.
